recovery.qualifyingDay: a campaign day on which NO labor action (labor == true) was executed. recovery.streakReset: at the sleep boundary, if the day was NOT a qualifying day: recoveryStreak = 0 — exactly: if qualifyingDay == false: recoveryStreak = 0. clientSprint.automation: Trusted Pro (reputation >= 80): SAFE-tier sessions may auto-resolve (recorded neutral table, no sprint; token + session energy still consumed). Skilled sprint play raises realized EV and poor play lowers it — the same skill-reward structure as the career-lane 0.7x-1.3x performance multiplier. The 12 recorded figures are the neutral-play reference, not a cap.

mastery.flowState: 3 consecutive ACTIVE sessions at >=80% in the same hustle -> 'flow state': the third qualifying session itself and every subsequent session that week (while the streak is unbroken) receives +10% session RECEIPTS (before COGS). The streak counter resets to 0 at each Monday 00:00 week tick; a completed active session <80% resets it to 0; AUTO-RESOLVED sessions neither extend nor reset the counter (frozen). The bonus flows into receipts and therefore into taxableBase.
mastery.masterTier: reputation >= 80: SAFE-tier sessions may auto-resolve (recorded neutral table, no sprint). reputation >= 90: RISKY-tier sessions may auto-resolve (recorded neutral table, no sprint). Bounded PREMIUM auto-resolve: up to 3 Premium sessions per week may auto-resolve at 85% of the player's trailing-4-week average ACTIVE Premium net per session (requires >=4 active Premium sessions in the trailing 4 weeks to establish the average; otherwise 85% of the recorded neutral-table receipts/COGS — see business.masterTier.autoResolve.ledgerAccounting). The monthly Big Job must be played ACTIVELY and explicitly SATISFIES (counts as) that week's required active Premium session — business.bigJob.economy.countsAs ('the week's required active Premium session') is the authority, aligned here. In weeks WITHOUT a big job, at least one Premium session must be played actively (these generate teacher explanation evidence). Premium auto-resolve never counts toward flow-state streaks. Slot protection: in non-Big-Job weeks, Premium auto-resolve unlocks only after the week's required active Premium session is completed.
mastery.rationale: progression, not grind: demonstrated mastery unlocks delegation at a real cost (85%), while the highest-stakes work still requires regular active play
mastery.requestSeed: requestSeed = fnv1a32(hustleStreamSalt, sessionId); the 8-request order is generated from mulberry32(requestSeed) and consumes NO hustle-stream values. Session draw order: (1) derive request seed, generate request sequence; (2) draw outcome tier from the hustle stream; (3) apply Sprint performance shift (>=80% improves one tier, 50-79% unchanged, <50% worsens one tier).

clientSprint.outcomeShift: >=80% -> the drawn outcome improves one tier (flop->average, average->good; good stays good); 50-79% -> the drawn outcome stands; <50% -> the drawn outcome worsens one tier (good->average, average->flop; flop stays flop)
clientSprint.reputationFollows: reputation deltas (+8/+4/+1, quit -5) apply to the FINAL post-Sprint outcome tier (the shifted outcome the client sees)
clientSprint.scoring: sprintScore = correct / 8; the request order is seeded per session (reproducible)

No silent debt is created, and no incurred expense ever disappears through suspension. Cleared ONLY by txn.overheadPayableSettlement, invoked atomically by any business-cash increase (txn.businessCashInject, txn.restartAdvanceIssuance, txn.sessionSettlement).

cabinets.rngAlgorithm: seed s: ONE uint32 draw from the arcade stream per play (draw counts pinned in rngDraws). Prize placement: the 5-item weekly pool is placed on a 5x2 slot grid — for item i (0..4), slot_i = (s >> (4*i)) mod 10, collision fallback: probe slot_i = (base_i + 7*k) mod 10 for k = 0,1,2,... until a FREE slot is found (at most 10 probes; 5 items in 10 slots always terminates — v7.12, repeated probing). Geometry: column c = slot mod 5, row r = slot div 5; pixel position = (40 + c*56, 120 + r*48) on the 320x240 playfield. Sway: 3 more draws d1,d2,d3 -> amplitude_deg = 8 + 14*d1, period_s = 1.6 + 1.2*d2, phase_rad = 2*pi*d3. Consecutive-WIN-day streak multiplies amplitude deterministically per streakMultiplier (amplitude_deg = (8 + 14*d1) * min(2.0, 1 + 0.15 * streak)). Identical seeds reproduce identical layouts.
cabinets.rngDraws: arcade stream, per play IN FIXED ORDER: 1 draw seeds prize placement; 3 draws drive the 3 sway oscillations. Identical seeds reproduce identical runs.

streakMultiplier.rule: The consecutive-WIN-day streak multiplies the base sway amplitude deterministically: amplitude_deg = (8 + 14*d1) * min(2.0, 1 + 0.15 * streak). This is the versioned formula the brief's 'increasing sway on consecutive win days' promise resolves to.

cabinets.rngAlgorithm: seed s: ONE uint32 draw from the arcade stream per play. Expand with splitmix64: for note i in 0..31: lane_i = splitmix64(s, 2*i) mod 4 (4 lanes); time_i = i*0.5 + (splitmix64(s, 2*i+1)/2^64 - 0.5)*0.12 seconds. The 32-note pattern (lanes + timestamps) is fully determined by s. Identical seeds reproduce identical patterns. (splitmix64(s, index) is the exact helper in marketModel.rng.helpers.splitmix64_2arg: (index+1)-th sequential output, never a sub-seed)
cabinets.rngDraws: arcade stream, per play: 1 draw seeds the note-pattern generator; the 32-note pattern is then fully deterministic from the seed. Identical seeds reproduce identical runs.

cabinets.rngAlgorithm: seed s: ONE uint32 draw from the arcade stream per play. arrearsModel.lateFee: $25 ADDED to arrears (the only new debt -- the penalty) via txn.lateFee; one fee per contract-period, never per missed sub-installment
arrearsModel.maturity: at maturity, any outstanding balance is retained as due (a single collectible obligation) -- no phantom new installments are created
arrearsModel.paymentAllocation: catch-up payments allocate in order: late fees -> arrears -> current
arrearsModel.reclassification: for a missed scheduled payment S against current portion C: reclassify = min(S, max(C, 0)); arrears += reclassify; current -= reclassify. Arrears always references identifiable unpaid installment amounts; both partitions stay non-negative and always sum to the carrying balance.

Coffee is NOT food and is excluded from auto-consumption (see freshMart.coffeeRule). Energy accrues into the per-item fractional accumulator at full precision; whole points post to the energy ledger at integer crossings (freshMart.energyLedger is the single posting rule — no per-item per-sleep rounded posting).
freshMart.energyLedger: The energy ledger is the SINGLE posting rule and is whole-point with per-item true-up (ITEM-LEVEL TRUE-UP). Per-item fractional energy accumulates at full precision as calories are consumed; WHOLE energy points are posted to the ledger when the accumulator crosses an integer boundary. When an item is FULLY CONSUMED (all its calories eaten), the remaining fractional accumulator is flushed with a final posting of round-half-up(accumulator), so one fully consumed item's total posted energy equals exactly item.energy — conservation relative to calories actually consumed. On SPOILAGE the remaining accumulator is discarded (never posted, never true-upped): spoiled food grants no energy. No energy is created or destroyed; the whole-point cap for ordinary postings is sleep.energyMaximum = 100; sleep-sequence step-4 food-energy postings use sleep.wellFedCeiling = 110 as their cap — food energy above 110 is discarded, never banked.
freshMart.happinessLedger: Happiness posts exactly once per item on first consumption: when an item's consumedCalories transitions 0 -> >0 and happinessPosted == false, post item.happy to happiness ONCE and set happinessPosted = true. Spoiled items never post happiness (their accumulator is discarded with the item). Coffee happiness is posted by the atomic freshMart.coffeeResolver, never by this ledger.

helpers.fnv1a32_2arg: fnv1a32(init, s): 32-bit FNV-1a over the UTF-8 bytes of s with the initial hash state = init (the first argument REPLACES the standard offset basis 2166136261; it is not prepended to s nor XORed post-hoc). init may be a 32-bit constant (e.g. 0x72656164), a stream salt, or (salt XOR campaignSeed) reduced mod 2^32. mulberry32(fnv1a32(init, s)) is the sub-seed.
helpers.splitmix64_2arg: splitmix64(s, index) — the exact two-argument helper used by the arcade rngAlgorithms. CONSTANTS: increment 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; multipliers 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9 and 0x94D049BB133111EB; shifts 30, 27, 31. STATE MACHINE: state_0 = s (uint64). One step: state += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; z = state; z = (z XOR (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9; z = (z XOR (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EB; out = z XOR (z >> 31). splitmix64(s, index) = the (index+1)-TH sequential output: run index+1 steps starting from s (index is the step count, NOT a sub-seed — a direct sub-seed interpretation is explicitly wrong). All arithmetic is unsigned 64-bit (mod 2^64); the returned value is the uint64 output word — lanes/timestamps derive by mod and division exactly as each cabinet's rngAlgorithm states. Identical (s, index) -> identical word on every platform.

tokenTrader.attemptSeedDerivation: attemptSeed = campaignSeed XOR ((attemptCounter x 0x85EBCA6B) mod 2^32). attemptCounter is ONE persistent campaign-wide counter: starts at 0, advances once per Token Trader play, never resets within a campaign, never per-day. The seed is derived from the campaign seed and the attempt counter only. Every attempt receives a distinct seed by construction. Update boundary (PINNED): at play start, counterUsed = attemptCounter; attemptCounter += 1 atomically in the same write as the paid-attempt commitment; attemptSeed = campaignSeed XOR ((counterUsed x 0x85EBCA6B) mod 2^32). The FIRST attempt of a campaign uses counterUsed = 0 (attemptCounter persists from 0). The seed is always derived from counterUsed, never from the post-increment value.

updateRule: 1. draw commonShock ~ Normal(0, commonShockSigma) from the market stream
2. for each stock in drawOrder: draw idiosyncraticShock ~ Normal(0, volatilitySigma[stock]) from the market stream
4. if a news event targets this stock this month: rawNext *= event multiplier (applied after shocks, before rounding)
5. price_next = round2(max(0.00, rawNext)) — prices can reach $0.00; there is no guaranteed resale floor
6. ZERO GUARD: if price_next == $0.00 -> status = HALTED immediately (buy/sell disabled, dividends $0); the default draw is skipped for this stock this tick
7. STATUS NORMALIZATION after the price update (before any default draw): price == $0.00 -> HALTED; price <= $2.00 -> DISTRESSED; else -> ACTIVE
8. DEFAULT DRAWS only for stocks whose normalized status after step 7 is DISTRESSED: u ~ Uniform(0,1) from the market stream; u < 0.20 -> DEFAULTED (price = $0.00, status HALTED)

9. FINAL NORMALIZATION after defaults: price == $0.00 -> HALTED; price <= $2.00 -> DISTRESSED; else -> ACTIVE. Dividend eligibility is read from this finalized status, never from an intermediate state.

lifecycle.oneActiveServicePlan: a campaign has at most ONE active service plan (light / full / contract / rival12mo) at a time; the active plan is the plan under which the 40% debt-service test, throttling rules, and dispatch requirements are evaluated
lifecycle.purchaseGate: Purchase allowed only when no service plan is active (otherwise use phonePlanSwitch). ORIGINATION UNDERWRITING: purchase is gated by the SAME 40% debt-service accept test as switching, computed with the NEW plan's monthly price. Plans that count toward the 40% test: the active service plan (light $25, full $45, contract $35, rival12mo $30), handset financing $25/mo (actions.handsetFinance), and contract-device buyout installments (phone.contractDevice). Switching re-runs the test with the new plan's price.
lifecycle.recurringChargeTiming: The purchase-time cash charge covers exactly 30 campaign days of service (activationDay .. activationDay+29). The recurring charge posts as a day-tick obligation on campaignDayIndex = activationDay + 30k for k >= 1 (exact 30-campaign-day cadence); the first recurring charge posts on activationDay + 30 even when that day is not a month boundary. Switching resets the cadence: the new plan's first charge posts immediately at the switch day tick and its recurring obligations follow switchDay + 30k.
lifecycle.renewalSettlement: ONE renewal rule: at each 30-day renewal tick, auto-debit personal cash UP TO the amount due; the charge is satisfied to the extent of available cash; ONLY the unpaid remainder posts as a named obligation (txn.phoneRenewal) — personal cash is NEVER driven negative by a renewal. This reconciles the 'Contract payments stay automatic' promise (the auto-debit always happens at posting) with the obligation/suspension path (it applies ONLY to the unpaid remainder). An unpaid remainder suspends service at the next day tick with a $25 late fee (contracts.lateFee); paying balance + fee restores service.
lifecycle.switchSettlement: NO-PRORATION settlement (the only settlement rule): the switch FIRST settles terminationTerms(activePlan, 'switch', day) — on the 24-month contract that is the $200 fee PLUS the handset return/buyout, settled BEFORE the old entitlement ends (the handset arbitrage is closed: no path keeps the handset without the return-or-buyout settlement). Then: the old plan's entitlement ENDS at the switch day tick and its remaining prepaid days are FORFEITED (no credit, no refund); the new plan's entitlement STARTS at the switch day tick; the new plan's first charge (covering the next 30 days from the switch day) posts immediately; the new plan's recurring cadence is 30-campaign-day from the switch day. Never a double month, never a partial credit — the switch confirm screen states the forfeiture.

equityProvenance.rule: Home equity is tracked in TWO provenance buckets per owned property — never by home age (the ownership-duration proxy is DELETED — no home-age test exists). ONE dollar-level allocation formula governs every equity dollar, so no down-payment dollar can hide in the protected bucket: (1) nonDiscretionaryEquity: (a) the REQUIRED MINIMUM down payment = min(actual down payment, mortgages.downPaymentMinimumPct% of purchase price = 5% of purchase price) — forced home wealth, NEVER added back; (b) scheduled mortgage principal payments; (c) market appreciation. (2) discretionaryParkedEquity: (a) EVERY down-payment dollar ABOVE the required minimum (downPayment - requiredMinimum); (b) tracked extra-principal prepayments (actions.mortgagePrepay); (c) cash property-buy/upgrade inflows sourced from retained liquid assets; (d) any liquid funds deliberately moved into the property. Allocation rule (atomic, at purchase): downPayment dollars = requiredMinimum + parkedDown, where requiredMinimum = min(downPayment, 0.05 x purchasePrice) enters nonDiscretionaryEquity and parkedDown = downPayment - requiredMinimum enters discretionaryParkedEquity; every scheduled principal payment enters nonDiscretionaryEquity; every extra prepayment enters discretionaryParkedEquity; appreciation enters nonDiscretionaryEquity. No equity dollar is ever in both buckets — the two buckets always sum to total home equity. The means test adds back ONLY the discretionary-parked bucket. Worked hostile example: $60,000 apartment, $20,000 down -> requiredMinimum = $3,000 (protected); $17,000 parked (added back). Deliberate down-payment parking can no longer manufacture eligibility.

meansTest.rule: The means test adds back DISCRETIONARY outflows (extra mortgage principal, property purchases, investment buys, above-target savings transfers) that are still retained in illiquid destinations — deliberate liquid-asset parking is still added back with NO TIME LIMIT. Home equity is split by PROVENANCE, never by home age (recoveryGrant.equityProvenance): non-discretionary equity (the required-minimum down payment, scheduled principal, appreciation) is NEVER added back; every down-payment dollar ABOVE the required minimum IS added back with no time limit, as is discretionary parked equity (tracked extra prepayments, cash buy/upgrade inflows from retained liquid assets) — farming stays detectable because the parked provenance is preserved. A standalone propertySale path is registered (actions.propertySale), so an illiquid homeowner always has a sale route that the means test can observe.

sleep.energyCapBehavior: The sleep restore and all ordinary postings clamp energy at 100 — energy never exceeds 100 from those steps. ONLY the post-restore food-energy bonus (step 4) may carry energy above 100, up to the hard well-fed ceiling of 110 (sleep.wellFedCeiling); food energy above 110 is discarded, never banked. No other step may exceed 100.
sequence: 1. Spoilage: remove expired perishables from inventory (freshMart.spoilage: perishables with (dayIndex - purchaseDayIndex) >= expiryDays) — wasted calories are logged as spoiled; spoiled food grants no calories, energy, or happiness, and its fractional energy accumulator is discarded.

2. Pre-sleep food-adequacy snapshot of the REMAINING EDIBLE inventory: record edible fridge calories AFTER spoilage removal and BEFORE auto-consumption. The hungry test reads THIS snapshot: >= 2,000 cal is adequate (the boundary is inclusive); the test never reads the post-consumption fridge.
3. Food consumption: auto-consume fresh groceries at the sleep boundary in freshMart.consumptionOrder; per-item fractional energy accrues at full precision into the accumulator (no posting yet).
4. Restore energy to 100 (the sleep restore; clamps).

5. Food-energy bonuses post AFTER the restore: whole energy points cross from the food accumulator into the energy ledger (freshMart.energyLedger is the single posting rule) — food provably has an effect: these postings may carry energy above 100 up to the well-fed ceiling of 110 (sleep.wellFedCeiling); food energy above 110 is discarded, never banked.
6. Apply hunger and other starting modifiers as applicable: if the pre-sleep snapshot showed < 2,000 cal, sleep.hungerEnergyAdjustment (-20).
7. Subtract arcade deferred liability (actions deferredEnergy) and clear it.

Advance repayment is capped at the remaining balance: min(outstandingAdvance, 10% of receipts).
